description: This file defines a template class SocketServerType within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It implements a socket server with client management, including connection handling, message submission, and client iteration. It also includes nested classes for client iteration and socket handling, with methods for managing client connections, suspending, closing, and accepting new clients.

classes.name: SocketServerType
classes.description: A template class implementing a socket server with client management, connection handling, and message passing.

classes.name: IteratorType
classes.description: A nested class providing iteration over connected clients.

classes.name: SocketHandler
classes.description: A nested class managing socket listening, client connections, and client list management.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the socket server to accept connections.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket server and all client connections.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up closed or suspended clients from the client list.

methods.name: Client
methods.description: Retrieves a client proxy by ID.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends a client connection by ID.

methods.name: LocalNode
methods.description: Sets the local node ID for the socket server.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a message/package to a client by ID.

methods.name: Clients
methods.description: Returns an iterator over current clients.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of connected clients.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the socket handler for thread safety.
